mechanism_narrative: A low and stable federal funds rate environment, as measured by FEDFUNDS below 3.0%, compresses the risk-free rate used in equity valuation models, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 55% or more of the monthly observations when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals weakening labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of the months when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of the months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 200), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of the periods when CPIAUCSL > 200 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 115.0 indicates robust supply chain activity and strong economic output, which typically supports corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 55% or more of the months when INDPRO > 115.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 2200.0 thousand units signals a contraction in the residential sector, which is a leading indicator of weakening consumer demand and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of the months when HOUST < 2200.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a deteriorating labor market, which typically precedes a recession and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of the months when UNRATE increases and PAYEMS decreases from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 > 10900), a decline in real sales (RSAFS) signals the end of the expansion phase, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of the periods when GDPC1 > 10900 and RSAFS declines from the previous month.
